description: Editorial statue/book story in a rounded preview, with purple accents, circular paths and an external project-file promotion.

techniques.name: Object-centered editorial reveal
techniques.evidence: Statue, book cover and skull illustrations occupy a stable central object area while text changes.
implementation: Keep an object anchor and fixed text zones.
Animate alpha, position and focus separately.
Use a short eased entrance without inventing a true 3D model.

typography: Compact editorial text with purple keyword emphasis.
composition: Centered isolated objects and small labels inside the upper card; editor strip outside the composition.
effects: Focus blur, object scale changes and circular graphic paths.
easing: Exact source interpolation is uncertain. Any stored guidance is an original cubic-ease design recommendation, not a recovered curve.

tutorial.interface: After Effects icon and project-file timeline banner outside the result card.
tutorial.limitations: No instruction steps; the sampled objects may be rendered stills or cutouts.

uncertainties: Exact font family and original keyframe/easing parameters are not recoverable from these sampled frames.
Intervals are approximate observations, not audio-aligned or frame-precise annotations.
reviewer: Codex visual review of sampled source frames
